Test Scenario: Verify booking creation with valid data
Preconditions: Restful Booker API is accessible and Postman is available.
Test Steps:
1. Open Postman.
2. Create a POST request.
3. Enter the endpoint specified in Test Data.
4. Set Body to raw JSON.
5. Enter the valid booking data specified in Test Data.
6. Add response validation tests in the Post-response script.
7. Click Send.
8. Verify the response status code and booking details.
Test Data:
HTTP Method: POST
Endpoint: https://restful-booker.herokuapp.com/booking
Content-Type: application/json
Request Body:
{
  "firstname": "John",
  "lastname": "Smith",
  "totalprice": 250,
  "depositpaid": true,
  "bookingdates": {
    "checkin": "2026-12-10",
    "checkout": "2026-12-15"
  },
  "additionalneeds": "Breakfast"
}
Expected Results:
1. The API returns HTTP status code 200 OK.
2. The response contains a bookingid of type number.
3. The bookingid is greater than 0.
4. The returned firstname is "John".
5. The returned totalprice is 250.
Actual Results:
1. The API returned HTTP status code 200 OK.
2. The response contained a bookingid of type number.
3. The bookingid was greater than 0.
4. The returned firstname was "John".
5. The returned totalprice was 250.
6. All 5 Postman tests passed.

Test Scenario: Verify retrieving an existing booking by ID
Preconditions: A booking has been successfully created and its booking ID is available.
Test Steps:
1. Open Postman.
2. Create a GET request.
3. Enter the endpoint specified in Test Data.
4. Append the existing booking ID to the URL.
5. Click Send.
6. Verify the response status code and booking details.
Test Data:
HTTP Method: GET
Endpoint: https://restful-booker.herokuapp.com/booking/{`{bookingid}`}
Booking ID: An existing booking ID returned by POST /booking
Request Body: None
Expected Results:
1. The API returns HTTP status code 200 OK.
2. Firstname is a non-empty string; totalprice is a number.
Actual Results:
1. The API returned HTTP status code 200 OK.
2. The response contained a firstname field with the value "John".

2. Verify HTTP status. 
3. Verify updated firstname and totalprice.

Endpoint: https://restful-booker.herokuapp.com/booking/{{bookingId}}
Authorization: Basic Auth
Updated firstname: Peter
Updated totalprice: 350
